constraints.ocl:
context Reservation
inv: (self.copy <> null) and (self.expiryDate = self.requestDate)

context Book
inv: self.pages >= 20 and self.pages <= 95

context Book
inv: self.authors->any(x | x.name <> '') <> null

context Category
inv: self.books->any(x | x.publishYear <= 100) <> null

context Loan
inv: self.returnDate <> null and self.dueDate <> null

context Loan
inv: self.dueDate <> null implies self.startDate <> null

context Loan
inv: self.returnDate <> null implies self.startDate <> null

context Loan
inv: self.startDate <> null implies self.dueDate <> null

context Book
inv: (self.copies->exists(x | x.barcode <> '')) and (not(self.copies->exists(x | x.barcode <> '')))

context Book
inv: (self.copies->collect(x | x.loans)->size() >= 3) and (not(self.copies->collect(x | x.loans)->size() >= 3))

context Book
inv: (self.publishYear >= 2 and self.publishYear <= 15) and (self.publishYear < 2)

context Copy
inv: ((self.book <> null) and (self.barcode.toUpperCase() = 'TEST')) and (not((self.book <> null) and (self.barcode.toUpperCase() = 'TEST')))

context Book
inv: (self.publishYear mod 6 = 0) and (not(self.publishYear mod 6 = 0))

context Branch
inv: (self.address <> null) and (not(self.address <> null))

context Copy
inv: ((self.book <> null) and (self.loans->isEmpty())) and (not((self.book <> null) and (self.loans->isEmpty())))

context Loan
inv: (self.dueDate <> null implies self.returnDate <> null) and (not(self.dueDate <> null implies self.returnDate <> null))

context Book
inv: (self.pages mod 2 = 1) and (not(self.pages mod 2 = 1))

context Publisher
inv: ((self.books->exists(x | x.pages < 100)) and (self.books->size() >= 1)) and (not((self.books->exists(x | x.pages < 100)) and (self.books->size() >= 1)))

context Librarian
inv: (self.managedBranch <> null) and (not(self.managedBranch <> null))

context Copy
inv: (self.branch <> null) and (not(self.branch <> null))
